notes.title: 🔧 Revamped Anomaly Scanner
notes.content: [p]A major visual and gameplay update is here — the [b]completely redesigned anomaly scanner[/b]. As a core tool in identifying and dealing with anomalies, the scanner has received a full visual and functional overhaul.[/p][p][/p][h1]📡 [b]What’s new:[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Brand-new design inspired by cold war military tech[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced visual effects and interface[/p][/*][*][p]More detailed animations and environmental feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Built with future anomaly detection mechanics in mind  This update is part of our broader goal to deepen the oppressive, psychological atmosphere of the underground bunker — where survival depends on observation, caution, and quick decision-making.  💬 Feedback is always welcome — let us know what you think of the new scanner and what features you'd like to see in future updates.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support.[/p][/*][/list]
